mappings.reasoning: Handle is a URL slug of the product name, not a brand; no good target match, so it is dropped rather than forced into brand.
Variant SKU codes like VLD-BAG-LUNE-NR are product SKUs and map directly to the sku target.
Title holds the human-readable product name, which corresponds to the name target.
Product type values (Bags, Accessories, Shoes, Ready-to-wear) are product categories.
Price is the selling amount and maps to price.amount as a decimal.
Compare-at price is a sale reference amount, not a currency; it has no target and is dropped.
Option1 mixes colors (Black, Ivory, Navy) with sizes (38, 40), so it cannot be mapped cleanly to color or size; needs human review.
Option2 mixes sizes (One Size, 90x90) and colors (Brown, Camel), so it does not map to material; needs human review.
Inventory quantity is an integer count that maps to stock_quantity.
